frictions.description: Playwright Chromium headless shell missing system library dependencies (libnspr4.so, libnss3.so, etc.). Had to manually download .deb packages and extract shared libraries, then set LD_LIBRARY_PATH for every agent-browser command.
frictions.resolution: Downloaded libnspr4, libnss3, and 14 other .deb packages via apt-get download, extracted to /tmp/chromium-libs/, set LD_LIBRARY_PATH for all agent-browser invocations.

frictions.description: Browser session crashed after ~2 minutes of running QEMU Wasm, requiring browser restart and full page reload. Lost all emulator boot progress.
frictions.resolution: Restarted browser session and used shorter wait intervals instead of long sleep commands to maintain connection.

blockers.description: QEMU Wasm Worker thread failed to allocate 2300MB WebAssembly linear memory in headless Chromium. V8 internal error 'Array buffer allocation failed' appeared but was not thrown as a JavaScript exception. Module.wasmMemory remained null, Module.HEAPU8 remained null. QEMU's main function never executed, so no VGA display output was produced within 300 seconds. This prevented testing all display rendering assertions (VAL-DISP-001/003/004/005/007/008) and the interactive display assertion (VAL-DISP-007).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Attempted two separate browser sessions. Verified system has 8.1GB available memory (should be sufficient for 2.3GB allocation). The headless chrome-headless-shell binary may have stricter memory limits than a full Chromium browser.

summary: Tested 20 assertions: 13 passed, 1 failed (VAL-DISP-006: loading indicator not visible between Start click and first VGA frame), 6 blocked (VAL-DISP-001/003/004/005/007/008: QEMU Wasm Worker failed to allocate 2300MB memory in headless Chrome, preventing any VGA display output). All HTTP header, control UI, error handling, debug panel, and code-inspected assertions pass. The app's initialization pipeline (downloading → compiling → initializing → ready) works correctly. Button states follow the specified state machine. Error handling code is comprehensive with unit tests.
